verdicts.reason: A and B look identical as far as I can see. Both have the same problems. The three tag pills are blown up into big zig-zagging bars that compete with the RSVP button. The date line is centred, but the time and location text under it is left-aligned and ragged. The headline block is crammed under the logo while there is empty space around the product card. The partner placeholder in the bottom right is clipped and overlaps the URL area.
